Given at [BHASVIC](https://www.bhasvic.ac.uk/) (Brighton & Hove Sixth Form
College), this is a follow-up to the earlier
[Brighton Data Forum talk](../2025-03-26-bh-secondary-school-admissions-consultation/)
on Brighton & Hove secondary school admissions: which of the levers available
to the council actually shift the outcomes parents and policymakers care
about, and which just move numbers around on paper.
